title: Nano Punk Mecht
short_description: You are a young conscript extracted from a shelter and trained to pilot MECHTs in a future post-apocalyptic world of civil war and environmental collapse caused by an anomaly known as The Phage.
description:
You are a young conscript extracted from a shelter and trained to pilot MECHTs in a future post-apocalyptic world of civil war and environmental collapse caused by an anomaly known as The Phage.

A sci-fi visual novel with three characters, giant mecha battles against an unknown enemy, and ethical choices that decide the fate of your comrades. Hand-drawn art blends Western and Eastern 90s/00s aesthetics, with an original soundtrack.
